<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def Tstate(fr):
    s=fr.segmentation; bars={};stems={}
    for n in s['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b);r1=max(p[0] for p in b);c0=min(p[1] for p in b);c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['pixels']==3:
            if r0==42 and r1==42: bars[c0]=n['color']
            if r1-r0==2 and c1-c0==0: stems[c0]=n['color']
    return ''.join(bars[k] for k in sorted(bars))+'|'+''.join(stems[k] for k in sorted(stems))
def won():
    return last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('run_complete')
# set all-white: bar3 B->w, stem5 B->w
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':31}])
print("after bar3:",Tstate(current_frame),"won",won())
if not won():
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':41}])
    print("after stem5 (all-white):",Tstate(current_frame),"won",won())
if not won():
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':14,'col':31}])
    print("after SQUARE click:",Tstate(current_frame),"won",won(),"board_changed",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
    # did square move? check its position
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>=10 and n['pixels']<=16:
            b=n['boundary']; print("Y obj px",n['pixels'],"r",min(p[0] for p in b),"-",max(p[0] for p in b),"c",min(p[1] for p in b),"-",max(p[1] for p in b))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
